text:
kate: Proposing a lightweight "band + gate" flow to stop scope ping-pong. Bands = MVP / v1 / backlog. Gates = infra, compliance, effort, commercial. If any gate fails -> not MVP.

hez: Important: define effort threshold. I suggest <= 8 dev-days to be MVP-eligible.

miguel: Agree. Also call out perf-sensitive items (embedding cache) as infra-heavy -> likely out of MVP unless we find quantization wins.

noah: For large customer asks we can offer an opt-in staged rollout (API only) to keep core MVP clean. Sales must sign off.

kate: Timeline idea: this week owners fill gate matrix; next week we freeze band decisions; two weeks later QA/canary.

hez: I'll run a quick cost sensitivity and post numbers by EOD. If cache ups cost >15% it's a hard no for MVP.

miguel: I'll draft a brief comms note for customers explaining deferrals + staged option.

release-bot: doc-update  band-gates.md edited by kate at 3889991400.

kate: Action list: owners fill rows; @hez perf numbers; @miguel comms; reconvene Mon 10am to lock MVP.
